## Purpose

What question, issue, or project stage does this change address?

## Changes

- Describe the concrete changes here.

## Evidence

List the tests, figures, comparisons, or manual checks that support the change.

- [ ] Tests pass locally or an exception is explained.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts reflect changed behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, unrestricted data, generated artifacts, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Data or model changes identify the relevant configuration and manifest.
- [ ] User-facing analytical claims include uncertainty and limitations where relevant.

## Review notes

Call out assumptions, unresolved questions, breaking changes, and the parts that deserve the closest review.
